purpose: Debrief after a race; teach 競技/スキル/マシン/エリア/必死/武器/神経/競馬

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今日の競技、ようやった。
lines.en: You did well in today’s competition.
lines.style: proud Kansai coach praising, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 練習のスキル、活かせました。
lines.en: I used the skills from practice.
lines.style: satisfied athlete reflecting, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: あのマシン、フォーム改善に貢献したな。
lines.en: That machine helped improve your form.
lines.style: coach noting cause, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: スタートエリアで、緊張しすぎたかな。
lines.en: In the start area, I was maybe too tense.
lines.style: athlete self-critiquing, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええ、必死すぎるとよくない時もある。
lines.en: Yeah, being too desperate isn’t always good.
lines.style: coach offering balance, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも武器の脚力は、最後まで保てました。
lines.en: But I kept my leg-strength weapon to the end.
lines.style: athlete noting the win, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Your nerve is the real thing.
lines.style: coach praising mental strength, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 競馬の名馬も、こんな気持ちなのかな。
lines.en: I wonder if famous racehorses feel like this too.
lines.style: athlete musing fondly, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced
